name: Ai Suru Kanojo wa Gamen no Naka, Hoka no Otoko no Ue de Koshi o Furu ~You-kya no Douga Haishinsha ni Netorareta Ota Kanojo~
original_name: 愛する彼女は画面の中、他の男の上で腰をふる ～陽キャの動画配信者に寝取られたオタ彼女～
source: The protagonist begin to like a online streamer, then he begin to communicate with her online and give to her tips of how get more viewers. This is just a online friendship. After some time she disappear online, and then, by coincidence, he found out some porn videos of her in other online site.
translation: 主角开始喜欢上一位主播，并开始在网上与她交流，告诉她如何吸引更多的观众。这只是网上的友谊。一段时间后，她在网上消失了，然后，机缘巧合，他在其他网站上发现了她的一些色情视频。
